title: Super Cup ATTP – Autumn 2023: first stage
excerpt: Results of the first stage of SUPER CUP ATTP – Autumn 2023
body_html:
According to the results of the first stage of SUPER CUP ATTP – Autumn 2023 🏓🏆, the winners and prize-winners of the subgroups were:

- Group E

1st place – Împărățel Alexandru

2nd place – Todiraș Ion⭐️

3rd place – Conțu Oleg

- Group D

1st place – Tanurcov Stefan

2nd place – Zaporojan Vladimir⭐️

3rd place – Plescaci Vitalie⭐️

- Group C

1st place – Cîlcic Evghenii⭐️

2nd place – Crîmschi Denis

3rd place – Pisceanschi Vladimir⭐️

- Group B

1st place – Medînschi Oleg ⭐️

2nd place – Donoaga Mihai ⭐️

3rd place – Grimaldi Alessio⭐️

- Group A

1st place – Cucerovschii Serghei ⭐️

2nd place – Tudorean Cristian ⭐️

3rd place – Bobeico Igor

We sincerely thank everyone who spent the autumn 2023 season with us (ATTP/SETKA-PRO/TOP CUP Academy). Together we are engaged in a great and important task — bringing the best of our society to table tennis and instilling a love of a healthy lifestyle in hundreds of good people across Moldova.

We wish tomorrow’s participants in the second stage of the competition every success, beautiful play and a worthy contest!🤝💪
